figmaCorrections.issue: Card border uses raw hex #e2e8f0, which is not one of the Stroke/* tokens (#f3f4f6 / #e5e7eb / #f9fafb).
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Replace #e2e8f0 with the nearest Stroke token (#e5e7eb, Stroke/200) so the card border is token-bound.

figmaCorrections.issue: The Text/Hint variable resolves to #374151 in get_variable_defs, but every hint/muted string (search placeholder, column headers, profile role, pagination meta, inactive pages) renders as #6b7280.
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Fix the Text/Hint token to resolve to #6b7280 so the variable matches the rendered hint color across the screen.

figmaCorrections.issue: The frozen action column uses ad-hoc drop-shadow values (0 6 4 rgba(33,33,33,0.2), 0 2 4 rgba(33,33,33,0.04)) that differ from the Shadows/shadow-md token.
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Either bind the frozen column shadow to Shadows/shadow-md or add a dedicated shadow token so the value is not hardcoded.

figmaCorrections.issue: The Figma frame is named 'ADMIN / MANGAGE SCHEME' (misspelled 'MANGAGE').
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Rename the frame to 'ADMIN / MANAGE SCHEME'.

figmaCorrections.issue: Search placeholder is 'Search for ' with a trailing space and a truncated/incomplete label.
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Provide a complete placeholder (e.g. 'Search for scheme name') and remove the trailing space.

figmaCorrections.issue: Table inner layout has gap-[323px] as an auto-layout artifact between the scroll table and the frozen action column, which is not a real content gap.
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Clean up the auto-layout so the frozen action column is positioned without a spurious 323px gap that handoff consumers may misread.
